get_compensated_value = (temperature, ec) => {
	t20 = temperature-20.0
	A = 1.37023 * t20 + float(v: "8.36e-4")*(t20^2.0)
	B = 109.0 + temperature
	
	C = 0.889 * 10.0^(A/B)
	ec_25 = ec / C
	return ec_25
}

from(bucket: "B4:E6:2D:3D:91:4B")

    r._measurement == "measurements" and
    r._field == "temp_sensor_1_C" or r._field == "ec_raw_uS"
  )
	|> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: mean)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => (
      {r with _value:  get_compensated_value(ec: r.ec_raw_uS, temperature: r.temp_sensor_1_C)}
  ))

    |> rename(
        fn: (column) => {
            _newColumnName = if column =~ /^_value/ then "ec25_non-linear-model" else column
            return _newColumnName
        },
    )
